name: MercadoLibre

logo.source: en.wikipedia.org infobox logo (Mercado Libre logo (Spanish version).svg)

description: MercadoLibre runs Latin America's leading online marketplace (Mercado Libre) and its payments and banking arm (Mercado Pago), and the two feed each other. Commerce revenue (marketplace commissions, shipping through its own Mercado Envios logistics, advertising, first-party sales) was 56 percent of 2025 revenue; Fintech (payment processing on and off the marketplace, credit, asset management, insurance) was 44 percent and grew faster at 46 percent. The filing credits growth in credit originations and payment volume, funded partly by selling and securitizing receivables, for the 39 percent revenue increase. Brazil is the largest market by revenue, but Argentina earns the highest direct margin.

hq.note: Principal executive offices: Dr. Luis Bonavita 1294, Tower II, Montevideo (FY2025 10-K). Delaware corporation, registered office Dover, DE.

employees.note: Total by country (FY2025 10-K): Brazil 61,139; Mexico 34,336; Argentina 16,726; Colombia 5,848; Chile 3,617; Uruguay 1,858; others small. 20,347 are IT and product staff.

businessLines.name: Commerce
businessLines.how: Takes a commission and flat fees on each marketplace sale, charges for shipping and logistics, sells advertising to sellers, and books full revenue on the items it sells itself.
businessLines.description: Marketplace commissions and fees, Mercado Envios shipping, advertising, first-party retail sales, classifieds.

businessLines.name: Fintech
businessLines.how: Charges merchants a processing fee on each payment (on and off the marketplace), earns interest and fees on loans and credit cards it funds through receivable sales, securitizations and credit lines, and earns smaller fees on asset management and insurance.
businessLines.description: Mercado Pago: on- and off-platform payment processing, credit (cards and loans), asset management, insurance, digital accounts.

brands.name: Mercado Envios
brands.segment: Logistics; 10-K calls it integral to the value proposition; revenue not broken out
